units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 1:6">Makhsh. I, 6</cite> <he>מעשה … מפני הס׳</he> it happened in Jerusalem that they hid their fig-cakes in water to save them from the robbers (ref. to the terrorists during the last siege of Jerusalem, cmp. <cite ref="O00822"><he>סִיקְרָא</he> III</cite>); [Var. lect. <cite ref="O01632"><he>סְרִיקִין</he></cite>; R. Hai G. reads: <he>סיקריקין</he>, v. next w.] <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 2">Ab. d’R. N. II</cite>, ch. VII (ed. Schechter, p. 20) <he>עמדו כל הס׳ וכ׳</he> all the terrorists arose and burnt all the provision stores in Jerusalem; (<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 1">Ab. d’R. N. I</cite>, ch. VII <he>קנאים</he>).
